id.$comment: Must be unique for the identity. It can't be changed after adding a key. Included when signing state transitions to indicate which identity key was used to sign.

type.description: Public key type. 0 - ECDSA Secp256k1, 1 - BLS 12-381, 2 - ECDSA Hash160, 3 - BIP13 Script Hash, 4 - EDDSA 25519 Hash160
type.$comment: It can't be changed after adding a key

purpose.description: Public key purpose. 0 - Authentication, 1 - Encryption, 2 - Decryption, 3 - Transfer, 4 - System, 5 - Voting, 6 - Owner
purpose.$comment: It can't be changed after adding a key

securityLevel.description: Public key security level. 0 - Master, 1 - Critical, 2 - High, 3 - Medium
securityLevel.$comment: It can't be changed after adding a key

data.description: Base64-encoded raw public key or key hash
data.$comment: It must be a valid key of the specified type and unique for the identity (for key types 0 and 1). It can't be changed after adding a key

readOnly.description: Whether this key is read-only and cannot be disabled
readOnly.$comment: Defaults to false if not specified

contractBounds.description: Optional bounds restricting key usage to specific contract scope

oneOf.$comment: SingleContract - key can only be used within a specific contract
SingleContractDocumentType - key can only be used within a specific contract and document type

disabledAt.description: Timestamp indicating that the key was disabled at specified time. Although disabled keys cannot be updated, they can be used for signature verification. Timestamp must not be more than 5 minutes before or 5 minutes after the current platform chain block time
